display.title: Episode 523: The Mystery of Dayenu (Nissan)
display.summary_short: In the month of redemption, Uncle Yossi leads Tehillim for the Rebbe, a first-grade class says the Shema, and a king's lost ring is found when Seder guests sing 'Dayenu'.
display.summary_long: Broadcast at the start of Nissan 5752. Uncle Yossi recalls that the Jewish people were redeemed in Nissan and will be redeemed again in Nissan, and that children, who were the first to recognize Hashem at the Exodus, will play a central role in bringing Moshiach. Their pure voices in Torah and prayer can overturn any decree, as Mordechai's 22,000 children did. He then repeats the prayer for the Rebbe's recovery with Tehillim chapter 20, and a first-grade class from a Brooklyn yeshiva recites the Shema, both heard earlier before Purim. After tzedakah comes 'The Mystery of Dayenu'. Reb Sholom, famous for hachnasas orchim, cannot afford food for all his Pesach guests and prays with Tehillim. The king has lost his ring, and when Reb Sholom offers help, the king gives him a sack of gold. On Seder night the king passes Reb Sholom's window, hears the guests calling out 'Dayenu', the name of one of his servants, and finds the thief, and Reb Sholom receives the reward. After the Hakochainik march come Pesach reminders: helping parents clean, the Tzivos Hashem Pesach mitzvah chart, selling chametz, and candle-lighting times.
display.lesson: Hashem repays kindness: one who opens his home to guests is helped in ways he could never imagine.

date.note: 'Here we are already in the new month of Nissan', Pesach 'right around the corner', candle time 7:11 (after the switch to daylight time); two weeks after episode 521.
